title: Claude vs ChatGPT vs Gemini: Which AI Should You Actually Use?
style: Read this like a friendly, confident teacher explaining to a small business owner. Warm, clear, unhurried, natural pauses.

segments.title: Which AI should you pick? It depends on one thing
bullets: Where your work already lives
What you do most: write, search or create
How much you'll pay: $0 or about $20
segments.say: Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Which one should you actually use? The honest answer depends on one thing most comparison videos skip, and I'll show you that by the end. First, here's what matters: where your work already lives, what you do most every day, and whether you want to pay nothing or about twenty dollars a month.

segments.title: All three have a free plan
bullets: Free is enough to learn
Paid plans: about $20 a month
Prices change: check the official page
segments.say: Good news first. All three have a free plan, and free is enough to learn everything on this channel. The main paid plans are about twenty dollars a month each, and there are cheaper and more expensive options too. Prices change often, so always check the official pricing page before you pay.

segments.title: The all-rounder most people know
bullets: Very popular, lots of tutorials online
Text, images, voice in one app
Great if you want one tool for everything
segments.say: ChatGPT is the one most people have heard of. It's an all-rounder: writing, images and voice in one app, and there are tutorials for almost everything. If you want one tool that does a bit of everything, it's a safe choice.

segments.title: Best if you live in Google
bullets: Works inside Gmail, Docs and Drive
Built into many Android phones
Great with Google search
segments.say: Gemini is Google's assistant. If your business already runs on Gmail, Google Docs and Google Drive, Gemini fits right in, and it's built into many Android phones. If you live in Google, start here.

segments.title: Strong writer, connects to your tools
bullets: Clear, natural writing
Handles long documents well
Connectors: email, calendar, files
segments.say: Claude is known for clear, natural writing and for handling long documents. It can also connect to tools you already use, like your email, calendar and files, which is why we use it on this channel. But I'll be fair: you can follow every lesson here with any of the three.

segments.title: Give all three the same job
bullets: Use the exact same prompt
Ask for something you really need
Pick the answer you'd actually send
segments.say: Here's the best way to choose, and it's free. Give all three the exact same job, something you really need this week. Then pick the one whose answer you would actually send without fixing. That's your AI.

chat.user: I run a [furniture store]. A customer says our [sofa] price is too high. Write a friendly reply that explains the value and offers [free delivery]. Under 80 words.
chat.ai: (Example answer) Hi Sam, thanks for asking! Our sofas use solid hardwood frames and come with a 5-year warranty, so they last for years. To make it easier, we'll include free delivery this week. Want me to hold one for you?

segments.title: Our simple recommendation
bullets: Live in Gmail and Google Docs: Gemini
Want one app for everything: ChatGPT
Write a lot, want connectors: Claude
Not sure: try all three free for a week
segments.say: So here are quick picks. If you live in Gmail and Google Docs, start with Gemini. If you want one app for everything, ChatGPT. If you write a lot and want it connected to your tools, Claude. And if you're not sure, use all three free for one week with the same test.

segments.title: The skill matters more than the tool
bullets: A good prompt works in all three
Who, what, details, format
Switching later is easy
segments.say: And here's the one thing comparison videos skip. The tool matters much less than how you ask. A good prompt works in all three. Who, what, details, format, the formula from our first video. Learn that, and switching tools later is easy.
